observation: Parent NaFadeNet+ExtrapGate 3-split MAPE 0.1474 ± 0.0389. On split 2021 the learned gate never left its init (mean g 0.119-0.120 in every prefix band; a, c unchanged) because Adam moves each raw parameter by about lr = 5e-5 per step and a run has only ~180 steps, so the gate cannot express the prefix dependence the extrapolation needs (extrapolation MAPE 2.5-4.7 at prefixes 1-10 but 0.04-0.11 at 51-100).
primary_hypothesis: Re-parameterising only the gate and the extrapolation calibration (g = sigmoid(-2 + s*MLP), a = 2 + s*da, c = -3.6 + s*dc, s = 50, zero-init so the start equals NA-E006) lets these 99 head parameters move about 50x further per Adam step, so g learns to rise with prefix length, which lowers late-prefix MAPE without hurting early prefixes.
question_inherited: Is the fixed-blend behaviour of NA-E006 a gate-learning-speed limitation?
unresolved_from_reference: Gate stuck at init; late-prefix MAPE 0.10-0.12 on split 2021 while the extrapolation alone reaches 0.04-0.05 there.
why_this_experiment: A2 follow-up 2 of the active direction (Head). Codex marked the gate REPAIR in NA-E006. Optimizer and lr stay locked; only the parameterisation of the gate block changes.
modification: gate_param_scale = 50 on the NA-E006 head; everything else identical. Same parameter count (39,236).
held_constant_components: NaFadeNet body, extrapolation features, split 2021, seed 2021, Relative Huber 0.15, Adam 5e-5, batch 128, max 100 / min 5 epochs, patience 5, checkpoint rule, data, masks.
controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
expected_evidence: MAPE/RMSE/Acc@15 vs NA-E006; gate mean per prefix band; a, c movement; per-cell errors.
rejection_condition: Screen split 2021: DISCARD if MAPE >= 0.1053 (no gain over NA-E006) or UNHEALTHY or the gate still flat (band means within 0.02). Otherwise confirm on 42/2024; KEEP if the 3-split mean beats the parent 0.1474 by >= 0.008.
minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; NaFadeNet block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.

architecture_addendum.mechanism: reparameterised (scaled) gate logit and extrapolation calibration so the gate can adapt under the locked optimizer
architecture_addendum.shapes: identical to NA-E006: feats [B,4] -> gate MLP -> logit [B]; g = sigmoid(-2 + 50*logit) [B]; z_ext [B]; y = (1-g)*y_net + g*z_ext [B]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: unchanged from NA-E006 (masked last-20 fit, est clamped to >= n+1); unit test: padded-cycle change -> output diff 0.0; start output equals NA-E006 exactly (diff 0.0).
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: vs NA-E006 split 2021 (MAPE 0.1053, RMSE 24.0, Acc@15 0.687; DB-MAPE = MAPE): mean g by prefix band increasing from 1-10 to 76-100, lower prefix 51-100 MAPE, overall MAPE lower.
